title: Synaptics Patent Claims Reportedly Stop DisplayLink Driver Development
summary: Synaptics has reportedly asserted patent claims against work on DisplayLink drivers, stopping development, according to an LWN report. The dispute concerns open-source support for DisplayLink hardware, but the available excerpt does not identify the specific patents, the targeted project or developer, or whether Synaptics has filed litigation.
